summary: Opt-in native catalog gateway surface and peer replication

delivery.outcome: An opt-in gateway surface exposes the native Paxlet catalog (records, snapshot, package archive) under existing grants, and gossip pulls authenticated catalog snapshots plus missing verified package bytes only for explicitly mapped peers.
nonGoals: Replacing the legacy proc:// registry or package carrier
Executing resolved packages or changing grants

architecture.decision: TASKAND_CATALOG_ROOT opts the gateway into a native Catalog read/snapshot surface behind proc://taskand.dev/catalog/core/v1 grants; TASKAND_CATALOG_PEERS binds peer origins to node ids so gossip applies their snapshots via apply_snapshot after fetching only missing digest-pinned archives.
architecture.rollback: Unset TASKAND_CATALOG_ROOT/TASKAND_CATALOG_PEERS; the surface and sync are inert without them.

validation.evidence: Handler auth/disabled cases, real catalog snapshot apply between node stores, and gossip peer pull with digest-pinned archives
